policy.basis: Copyright and Related Rights Act NN 111/21, Article 18(3): officially published legal, administrative, and judicial texts (including statutes, regulations, and court decisions) cease to be protected by copyright when published for official public information.
policy.scope: Individually identified official legislative texts published in the Narodne novine official part; the four unchanged MUP EEA forms and three unchanged MUP SIS forms; and the identified MUP EEA guidance article body, all with source attribution under MUP Terms of Use; and the individual blank MVEP VIS administrative request form under a narrow Article 18(3) assessment. Excludes publisher page shells, third-party materials, other unreviewed page content, and bulk/database-wide reuse. The identified static AZOP complaint-route article body may also be reproduced with source attribution under AZOP Terms of Use checked 2026-10-25; the pack currently retains only the official link.
policy.retention_rule: Retain source-bound text fragments from the official Narodne novine document region; seven individually identified MUP form PDFs unchanged with MUP attribution; the Croatian article body of hr-mup-eea-guidance with source attribution under MUP Terms of Use checked 2026-10-24; and the one individually identified MVEP VIS request form under the narrow Article 18(3) assessment. Keep official citation, stable URL, review date and hashes. Preserve original PDF layout and page order; do not alter prescribed forms. Exclude publisher shells and unrelated or third-party content. The new SIS/VIS PDF page-image layout has not been visually reviewed. If a local AZOP copy is later selected, limit it to the static article body, identify AZOP and the official source URL, preserve the source meaning, and exclude the page shell, optional downloadable DOCX, live data-bearing form, and any user-submitted content.
not_covered: full publisher HTML responses and page-shell text
website design, navigation and interface text; page content outside the individually reviewed MUP and AZOP article bodies and forms accepted in this pack
third-party materials, non-text attachments, images and logos unless independently reviewed as individual official source documents
bulk extraction or reuse of the database as a whole, including any separate database right or technical conditions
MVEP website content and general guidance: the MVEP terms page inspected is a personal-data notice, not a general reuse grant
the AZOP optional downloadable complaint-form DOCX and live data-bearing online form; neither is retained or relied upon here

retrieval_constraints.individual_official_record_urls: use the stable Narodne novine/ELI record URL, not the metadata API as a full-text endpoint
retrieval_constraints.automated_request_rate: maximum three queries per second per the live Narodne novine data-access page
retrieval_constraints.full_page_response_retention: not in the repository; ignored local response may be used transiently to create the official-text fragment
